dataset: Homogeneous Indian Monthly Rainfall Data Sets (All-India and 36 Subdivisions)

resolution: Monthly and Seasonal (JJAS) regional means (36 subdivisions + All-India)
licence: Open Government Data (OGD) / Departmental Research Policy
licence_quote: The data is provided for research and academic purposes under Government of India Open Data directives; reproduction or derivative use requires proper acknowledgement of IITM Pune.
direct_download_url_or_api: https://www.tropmet.res.in/static_page.php?id=37 (Direct ASCII table download: IITM Research Report RR-138 monthly all-India and subdivision series 1871-2016; post-2016 extended via IMD CRS Pune annual monsoon reports at https://imdpune.gov.in/)

dataset: IMD High Spatial Resolution Daily Gridded Rainfall Dataset over India

provider: India Meteorological Department (IMD) / National Climate Centre Pune
resolution: Annual event date (Day of Year and calendar date)
units: Calendar date (DD-MM-YYYY) and departure from normal (days)

licence_quote: Monsoon Onset over Kerala (MOK) dates are official public domain operational records released by the India Meteorological Department for national and international public use.
